## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-35499e3f)

## Summary

REV44-QUALITYAUTH — `docs/reviews/rev43-producers.md` finding 4: the five measurement-quality authority writers (`save_timing_reference`, `save_excitation_asset`, `save_stimulus_profile`, `save_level_calibration`, `save_dataset_level_reference`) had zero production call sites, so the producer could never resolve beyond UNKNOWN, SPL-readiness stayed 'manual' forever, and the routing-profile combo was permanently 「（未選択）」-only. This PR wires honest registration surfaces for all five, following each family's data model — external evidence gets the calibration-file pick pattern (`read_file_bounded` → `save_*` → real filename + returned digest), derived/declared authorities get a typed dialog → `build_*` → `save_*`.

**Surface per family**

| Family | Surface | Consumer now reaches |
|---|---|---|
| `save_level_calibration` | 「機器の準備」→ 計測の権威データ → レベル校正「登録…」dialog (method/scoped scope driving enabled fields) | Onboarding `spl_readiness` step finally leaves 'manual' → 「準備完了」 |
| `save_timing_reference` | 「割り当て」取得条件 card: タイミング基準 combo (populated from new `list_timing_references()`) +「登録…」dialog; selection auto-fills signal path + sample rate | `commit_pending` persists context binding id+sha; producer's timing check can PASS → `common_timing` ALLOWED |
| `save_excitation_asset` + `save_stimulus_profile` | 刺激プロファイル「登録…」dialog with「ファイルを選択…」→ `read_file_bounded` → `build_excitation_asset` → `save_excitation_asset` (WAV header metadata honestly probed) → `build_stimulus_profile` | `list_stimulus_profiles` resolves the bound asset |
| `save_routing_profile` | ルーティングプロファイル「登録…」dialog deriving one channel-map row per speaker role (verification always starts 未検証 — never silently claimed) → `build_routing_profile` pinned to document + revision | `list_routing_profiles(document_id)` populates the combo |
| `save_dataset_level_reference` | 「品質」lifecycle card レベル基準 row「登録…」→ kind-aware dialog (calibration combo enabled only for `absolute_spl`) → `build_dataset_level_reference` → `reproduce_quality_report` seals the pin | Report re-derives; `absolute_spl` capability resolves ALLOWED where the calibration applies |

**New repository surface**: `list_timing_references()` and `list_excitation_assets(document_id)` (row-hash + re-validation on every read, same as existing listers). `MeasurementWorkflowController.reproduce_quality_report(measurement_id)` re-derives the report so a new pin lands in a fresh epoch.

**Honest-degradation preserved**: non-common-timing methods (imported/manual) bind as evidence but never produce `timing_reference_valid=True`; non-absolute level kinds need no calibration; `persistent` timing scope requires a signal-path identity; dialogs fail closed with JA typed errors and never persist partial records.

**Real-GUI verified** (seeded fixture-f1 project): all four 計測の権威データ rows register and count; SPL readiness flips to 準備完了; timing combo populates + auto-fills; routing combo offers `hdmi-avr-verified`; `sweep.wav` binds with real SHA-256; registering the absolute_spl level reference re-derives the report — 「絶対SPL：利用可能」.
